upstream_tests.reason_completion_stopped: A confirmed upstream failure already made the all-tests gate false; the remaining emulated x86 suite was stopped rather than spending additional compute that could not change the decision.
upstream_tests.failure_scope: Two entropy-pooling prior-view parser parameterizations reject a numeric value serialized with a zero imaginary component.

rationale: The predeclared whole-repository rule required every upstream test to pass. A real failure was reproduced on both native ARM and x86, so unrestricted use fails closed. A separately predeclared bounded component may be assessed independently.
